title: Reach Aggregation
description: How reach in a cross-buy aggregate was combined. This distinction determines whether aggregate reach is a valid denominator for frequency.

enumDescriptions.deduplicated: Unique reach deduplicated across every media buy included in the aggregate.
enumDescriptions.sum_of_constituent_reach: The arithmetic sum of independently unique per-buy reach values. A person, household, device, account, or cookie may therefore be counted more than once across buys.
